title.narrative: Support for Improving Maternal and Newborn Health through Health System Strengthening project in Kajiado County, Kenya

description.narrative: The project seeks to increase the number of essential equipment and commodities to Kajiado County County as part of the KOICA Kenya bilateral support to Kenya through The Improving Maternal and Newborn Health through Health System Strengthening in Kajiado County project. Kenya Good Neighbors is KOICA’s implementing partner for this project; responsible for the programmatic components and outputs. UNOPS supports the project through the rocurement of bio medical equipment, ambulances and motorcycles for the KOICA Health Strengthening project in Kajiado County.\n
